comparison.objective: Slide a slab off a free-wheeled rover without lifting it or moving the rover; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Frictional sliding with reaction-force control versus recessed-tool engagement, collar tuning, counterholding, and witness-torque testing.
comparison.success_condition: Slab on ground while rover remains stationary versus two acceptable damper cycles with no hard-stop strike or drift.
comparison.reason: The candidate does not test load unloading or base-motion suppression.
